# AWS Agent API Demo

This endpoint publishes machine-readable API access details for AI agents.

## API Entry Points
- GET /v1/health
- GET /v1/agent/tools
- POST /v1/agent/mock

Do not use `/legacy/*`. Those routes are a traditional RPC copy of the same mock and are not agent-friendly.

## Discovery
- /openapi.yaml
- /robots.txt

## Safety Notes
- This is a mock API for integration testing.
- Do not send secrets, credentials, or personal data.
